key.name: type
key.summary: Provider type
key.description: Set when the account is created and not changed afterwards.

key.name: name
key.summary: Account name

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show the account in the top bar

key.name: instance-id
key.summary: Random ID of this account
key.description: Set when preferences add or show the account, or when the extension starts running a listed account that has none. The saved usage state and the API key in the keyring belong to it, so that a reused slot never restores a removed account's reading, history or key. While it is empty, no state is saved and no API key is stored or read.

key.name: config-directory
key.summary: Configuration directory of the command-line tool
key.description: An absolute path that selects the CLI's login, passed as CODEX_HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Empty uses the CLI's default.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Refresh interval in seconds
key.description: Time between automatic usage checks. Shorter values than the provider's minimum are raised to it.

key.name: limit-id
key.summary: Usage bucket shown in the panel
key.description: The provider's bucket ID. Empty selects the provider's default bucket.

key.name: panel-window
key.summary: Usage window shown in the panel
key.description: 0 prefers weekly, falling back to the longest returned window. 1 uses the shortest returned window.

key.name: api-key-revision
key.summary: Changes whenever the account's API key is stored or removed

key.name: kimi-region
key.summary: Kimi Code service region
key.description: china uses api.kimi.com and international uses api.kimi.ai.

key.name: endpoint-url
key.summary: Custom endpoint URL

key.name: auth-header
key.summary: Header that carries the custom endpoint's key

key.name: auth-prefix
key.summary: Text sent before the custom endpoint's key

key.name: percent-pointer
key.summary: JSON Pointer to a percentage in the custom endpoint's response

key.name: percent-meaning
key.summary: Whether the custom endpoint's percentage is used or remaining

key.name: used-pointer
key.summary: JSON Pointer to the used amount in the custom endpoint's response

key.name: limit-pointer
key.summary: JSON Pointer to the limit in the custom endpoint's response

key.name: reset-pointer
key.summary: JSON Pointer to the reset time in the custom endpoint's response

key.name: window-minutes
key.summary: Length of the custom endpoint's usage window in minutes

key.name: usage-page-url
key.summary: Web page that shows the custom endpoint's usage

key.name: auto-redeem
key.summary: Redeem manual resets automatically before they expire
